note: Re-judged 2026-10-16: both units moved verbatim to internal/core/bgp/nlri/flowspec, only the family identifier changed to the test-local ipv4FlowSpec literal (AFI 1, SAFI 133). RFC 5575 Section 5.1: "This ordering function must be such that it must not depend on the arrival order of the flow specification's rules and must be constant in the network." TestFlowSpecPrecedenceFromWire requires Compare(a,b)<0, Compare(b,a)>0 and Compare(a,a)==0 over overlap, disjoint, component-type, operator-byte, received-width and extra-component pairs; TestRFC5575PrecedenceIndependentOfArrival parses independent copies in both arrival orders, sorts with production Compare and requires identical exact byte order. Compare (core compare.go) reads only component content, no identity or arrival metadata.
